description: Synthetic, hand-authored and hand-labeled evaluation dataset of 6 job descriptions and 10 resumes for fresher/early-career tech roles; it is intentionally small, and all requirement-presence and relevance labels were authored by the project developer independently of any matching method.
labelingGuidelines: present = true iff the resume genuinely shows the candidate has the requirement, whether in SKILLS, PROJECTS, EXPERIENCE or INTERNSHIP; a skill claimed in the skills list counts.

Synonyms, aliases and paraphrases count: Postgres = PostgreSQL, Go = Golang, Mongo = MongoDB, K8s = Kubernetes, JS = JavaScript, Node = Node.js, sklearn = scikit-learn, "built RESTful services" = RESTful APIs, "containerized the service" = Docker, "pipeline that builds, tests and deploys on every push" = CI/CD.

A related-but-different technology does NOT count: MySQL does not satisfy PostgreSQL (or vice versa), JavaScript does not satisfy Java, React Native does not satisfy React, Docker does not satisfy Kubernetes, TensorFlow does not satisfy PyTorch, Tableau does not satisfy Power BI, Vitest does not satisfy Jest.
For backend "RESTful APIs" the candidate must have built/designed APIs; for the frontend "REST API integration" requirement, consuming/integrating REST APIs from a client is sufficient.
Generic database requirements (e.g. "SQL") are satisfied by any SQL dialect the candidate has used (MySQL, PostgreSQL, coursework SQL).

relevance: 2 = strong fit (has most mandatory requirements, including the core stack), 1 = partial fit (some mandatory requirements or clearly transferable adjacent experience), 0 = poor fit; judged holistically as a recruiter would, consistent with the requirement labels.
Labels were authored before and independently of running any matching method (keyword, TF-IDF, embeddings or ontology); no label was tuned to favour a method.

jobs.title: Frontend Developer
jobs.text:
Frontend Developer (Fresher / 0-1 years)
We are a product startup building a B2B analytics dashboard used by 2,000+ small businesses. You will work with designers and backend engineers to build fast, accessible user interfaces.

Responsibilities:
- Build reusable UI components and pages for our web dashboard
- Integrate frontend screens with backend services and handle loading and error states
- Participate in code reviews and fix UI bugs

Requirements (must have):
- Strong fundamentals in JavaScript (ES6+)
- Hands-on experience building applications with React
- Solid HTML and CSS, including responsive layouts
- REST API integration (fetching, posting and handling data from backend endpoints)
- Version control with Git

Preferred (nice to have):
- TypeScript
- State management with Redux
- Unit testing with Jest

Location: Pune (hybrid). Freshers with strong projects are encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Backend Developer (Node.js / Express)
jobs.text:
Backend Developer - Node.js / Express (Fresher)
Our team builds the APIs behind a food-delivery logistics platform. You will design and maintain backend services consumed by our web and mobile apps.

Responsibilities:
- Design, build and document RESTful APIs
- Model data and write efficient queries
- Implement authentication and authorization
- Write clean, reviewed code and debug production issues with senior engineers

Requirements (must have):
- Node.js and Express
- Designing and building RESTful APIs
- MongoDB (schema design, indexing, aggregation basics)
- Git and pull-request based workflows

Preferred (nice to have):
- Experience with Postgres or another relational database
- JWT authentication
- Docker for local development and deployment

Location: Bengaluru (on-site). 0-1 years of experience; internships and personal projects count.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.text:
Data Analyst (Entry Level)
We are a retail chain with 120 stores looking for an entry-level analyst to turn sales and inventory data into decisions.

Responsibilities:
- Write queries to extract and clean data from our data warehouse
- Analyse sales trends, promotions and customer cohorts
- Build and maintain dashboards for store and category managers
- Present findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders

Requirements (must have):
- SQL (joins, aggregations, window functions)
- Python for data analysis
- Pandas for data cleaning and transformation
- Power BI dashboards and reports
- Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, lookups)

Preferred (nice to have):
- Tableau
- Statistics (hypothesis testing, regression basics)

Location: Mumbai (hybrid). Graduates from any discipline with strong analytical projects are welcome.

jobs.title: Java Backend Developer (Spring Boot)
jobs.text:
Java Backend Developer - Spring Boot (Fresher)
Join our fintech engineering team building payment reconciliation services used by partner banks. You will be mentored by senior engineers and learn code-quality, security and production-support practices from day one.

Responsibilities:
- Develop and maintain backend microservices
- Build RESTful APIs consumed by internal and partner systems
- Write database queries and manage schema changes
- Write unit tests and participate in code reviews

Requirements (must have):
- Core Java (OOP, collections, exceptions)
- Spring Boot
- Building RESTful APIs
- MySQL (schema design, joins, indexing)
- Git

Preferred (nice to have):
- Hibernate / JPA
- Maven build tool
- Unit testing with JUnit

Location: Hyderabad (on-site). 0-1 years of experience; strong academic or internship projects in Java are a plus.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer Intern
jobs.text:
Machine Learning Engineer Intern (6 months)
Our applied AI team builds document-understanding models for insurance claims. As an intern you will help train, evaluate and ship models, working closely with research scientists and product engineers and presenting your experiment results in weekly reviews.

Responsibilities:
- Prepare datasets and build training and evaluation pipelines
- Train and fine-tune models and track experiments
- Compare classical baselines with neural models
- Help package models for deployment

Requirements (must have):
- Python
- PyTorch
- scikit-learn
- NumPy

Preferred (nice to have):
- Deep Learning (CNNs, transformers)
- NLP experience (text classification, embeddings)
- Git
- Docker

Location: Remote (India). Final-year students and recent graduates may apply. Stipend provided; pre-placement offer possible based on performance.

jobs.title: DevOps / Cloud Intern
jobs.text:
DevOps / Cloud Intern
We run a SaaS platform on AWS and are looking for an intern to help automate infrastructure and deployments. You will be paired with a senior site reliability engineer and gain hands-on exposure to production systems.

Responsibilities:
- Containerize services and maintain deployment manifests
- Build and improve CI/CD pipelines
- Monitor environments and troubleshoot build and deployment failures
- Document infrastructure and runbooks
- Help reduce cloud costs by identifying and cleaning up unused resources

Requirements (must have):
- Docker
- Kubernetes
- AWS (EC2, S3, IAM basics)
- CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins or GitLab CI)
- Linux command line

Preferred (nice to have):
- Terraform
- Bash scripting
- GoLang for internal tooling

Location: Noida (hybrid). 6-month internship with possible full-time conversion.
